Our Story

Quality Kitchenware, Trusted Across Sri Lanka

ALMA'S KITCHEN was founded by Mohamed Asjath in Kalpitiya, Puttalam District, with one goal: make quality kitchen utensils, cookware and catering equipment easy to find and affordable for every home and business.

From everyday storage containers to full commercial catering setups, we source products that hold up to real, daily use — and back every order with reliable, island-wide service.

  • Quality-checked products
  • Household & commercial range
  • Reliable island-wide delivery
  • Friendly, personal service

Our Story

Quality Kitchenware, Trusted Across Sri Lanka

ALMA'S KITCHEN provides quality kitchen utensils, cookware, catering items and household kitchen products with reliable service across Sri Lanka — proudly based in Kalpitiya, Puttalam District.

10+Years Serving Kalpitiya
Why Alma's Kitchen

Built on Quality, Trust & Everyday Reliability

Founded by Mohamed Asjath, ALMA'S KITCHEN started with a simple goal: make quality kitchen essentials easy to find and afford for every home and business in Sri Lanka.

Today we supply everything from everyday storage containers and cookware to full commercial catering setups — sourcing products that hold up to real, daily use, and backing every order with friendly, reliable service.

  • Quality-checked products
  • Household & commercial range
  • Reliable island-wide delivery
  • Friendly, personal service
Quality FirstEvery product is checked before it reaches you.
Reliable DeliveryIsland-wide shipping you can count on.
Personal ServiceA family-run business that knows its customers.
Fair PricingPremium kitchenware at affordable prices.
Our Journey

A Decade of Growth

2016 — Humble BeginningsAlma's Kitchen opens its doors in Kalpitiya, serving local households with everyday kitchen essentials.
2019 — Expanding the RangeAdded cookware, bakeware and utensils to meet growing demand from customers across Puttalam District.
2022 — Entering CateringLaunched a dedicated catering equipment line to serve weddings, events and commercial kitchens.
2026 — Going OnlineAlma's Kitchen brings its full catalogue online, with island-wide delivery and secure payment options.

Mohamed Asjath

Founder & Owner, Alma's Kitchen

"We started Alma's Kitchen to make good quality kitchenware accessible to every home in Kalpitiya and beyond. A decade later, that same commitment to quality and service still guides everything we do — whether it's a single spice box or a full catering order for 500 guests."

Home / Terms of Service

Terms of Service

Last updated: July 2026

1. Introduction

Welcome to Alma's Kitchen. By accessing or using our website and placing an order, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree with any part of these terms, please do not use our website.

2. Products & Pricing

We make every effort to display accurate product information, pricing and availability. Prices are listed in Sri Lankan Rupees (LKR) and are subject to change without prior notice. In the event of a pricing error, we reserve the right to cancel or correct the affected order.

3. Orders & Payment

Orders can be paid via Bank Transfer (with slip upload for verification) or Cash on Delivery. An order is confirmed once payment is verified by our team, or immediately for Cash on Delivery orders. We reserve the right to refuse or cancel any order at our discretion, including in cases of suspected fraud.

4. Delivery

We aim to deliver orders within the estimated timeframe communicated at checkout. Delivery times are estimates only and may vary due to location, weather or courier delays beyond our control.

5. Returns & Refunds

Items may be returned within 7 days of delivery if unused, in original packaging, and accompanied by proof of purchase. Please contact our support team to initiate a return. Refunds are processed to the original payment method or as store credit, at the customer's choice.

6. Account Responsibility

You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials and for all activity that occurs under your account. Notify us immediately of any unauthorized use.

7. Limitation of Liability

Alma's Kitchen shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental or consequential damages arising from the use of our products or website, to the fullest extent permitted by law.

8. Changes to These Terms

We may update these Terms of Service from time to time. Continued use of our website after changes are posted constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.

9. Contact Us

Questions about these Terms can be sent to us via our Contact page or WhatsApp.

Home / Privacy Policy

Privacy Policy

Last updated: July 2026

1. Information We Collect

When you register, place an order, or contact us, we may collect your name, email address, mobile number, delivery address, and payment verification details (such as a bank transfer slip). We also automatically collect basic usage data such as pages visited to help us improve our service.

2. How We Use Your Information

We use your information to process and deliver orders, communicate order updates, respond to enquiries, verify payments, and improve our products and website experience. We do not sell your personal information to third parties.

3. Social Sign-In

If you sign in using Google or Facebook, we receive basic profile information (such as your name and email) from that provider to create or access your account. We do not post to your social accounts on your behalf.

4. Cookies

We use cookies and local browser storage to keep you signed in, remember your cart, and remember your theme preference. You can clear these at any time through your browser settings.

5. Data Sharing

We may share necessary order details (such as your name, address and phone number) with our delivery partners solely for the purpose of fulfilling your order.

6. Data Security

We take reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information. However, no method of transmission or storage is 100% secure.

7. Your Rights

You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data at any time by contacting us through our Contact page.

8. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. Any changes will be posted on this page with a revised "Last updated" date.
